title: Akzentae A
identity: Dietrich Erdmann’s Akzente A is an alto saxophone and piano work published by Breitkopf & Härtel, EB 9138. EDA Records lists three movements: Allegro con fuoco, Adagio espressivo, and Presto grotesco. The Philharmonie guide also lists a distinct tenor-and-piano work titled Akzente.

evidence.claim: Retailer lists Akzente A for alto saxophone and piano, Breitkopf EB 9138, ISMN.
Label page identifies the 1989/2003 work and its three movement titles within an album of Berlin alto saxophone and piano music.
Composer site search lead lists separate Akzente for tenor saxophone and piano; distinguish it from Akzente A for alto.
The guide’s separate tenor/piano Akzente entry is dated 1989 and has two movements.
evidence.source_name: Claude Delangle et al., 10 ans avec le saxophone (Philharmonie de Paris digital scan)

review_focus: Inference from movement titles: marked contrast across fiery, expressive slow, and grotesque presto character; no score notation inspected.
collection_flag: Original alto saxophone/piano work with commercial recording. A similarly titled tenor/piano Akzente appears in the reference guide; instrumentation must remain edition-specific.

listening.description: Akzente A, movements 1–3, on EDA 29: Music for Saxophone from Berlin Vol. 3.
